rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for entertainment or an entertaining activity.

example.english: Watching movies is my greatest amusement.
example.jyutping: tai2 hei3 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 jyu4 lok6

rows.note: Use this for a pastime or activity chosen to pass the time pleasantly, rather than entertainment in general.

example.english: I enjoy fishing as amusement when I’m off.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gaa3 zung1 ji3 diu3 jyu4 siu1 hin2

rows.note: Use this when the entertaining activity is recreational fun or play.

example.english: We get great amusement from playing together during the holidays.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fong3 gaa3 zau6 jat1 cai4 waan2 lok6
